title: 第44章 影刃交易第43章 回响议会
lines: 第44章影刃交易
“先封广场，护死王座。账别走公文口。绮雯那边一有回传，直接送实验室。”
梅洛应了一声，抱着卷宗就往外冲。
显曜已经把第七暗渠的冷蓝注流模型铺开，指尖在镜面上飞快划动。洛晖按住右臂冰层，刚转身，契约镜面忽然一闪。
绮雯的短讯压进来。
“到莱恩港了。旧防波堤下，暗影市场入口。”
海风钻进旧城区的防波堤底，只剩一股腥冷。
绮雯站在黑钢闸门前，拇指抹过暗影之刃刃心，一线冷蓝净火顺着指节爬上手腕。她又把那截从娜迦晶核手套上拆下来的灰烬供能管缠好，旧得发脏，像常年做暗活的人才会留下的东西。
门口两个退役铁卫，一高一矮，胸前都挂着赤金商会的铜牌。暗紫晶垢扫描器扫过来，在她腕口停了一下。
细光一串串跳起。
矮个铁卫看了她一眼，把暗码铜牌拍进她掌心。
“材料区先验货。别乱走。”
绮雯收牌进门。
洞窟被暗紫帷帐切成一格一格。湿石发冷，星火管线埋在四壁，时不时喷出一丝灰烬稳定剂细雾。空气里混着星盐、晶砂和焊焦味。
她没四处打量，只把步子放稳。
经过稳定剂摊位，停半息。
经过供能管残段，再停半息。
这是暗教中层买料的习惯。
她今晚先得像个买家。
材料区中段，一排旧货架上码着封装罐。绮雯指尖划过去，在第三只上停住。
罐底磨得厉害，边角崩了一块。
那枚旧印还在。
绮氏。
绮雯手指压上去，只一下，就松开了。
旁边的材料商披着灰斗篷，低头理木签。绮雯敲了两下货架，用暗语问价。
那人先看她腕上的供能管，才开口。
“三天前的新货。通道干净。”
“哪条通道？”
“曜都地底来的，没挂暗教牌子。”材料商把封罐翻过来，拇指蹭了蹭旧印，“送货那边嫌麻烦，擦都懒得擦。姓绮。”
绮雯没接话。
她只看了一眼侧边批号，记住了，转身就走。
够了。
绮仲那边不是漏。
是有人直接往外送。
再往里，就是拍卖暗舱区。
岩洞中央吊着一艘退役铁甲舰残骸，舰首剖开，甲板改成竞拍台。蓝帘买家，紫帘卖家，黑帘账房。
绮雯挑了间蓝帘暗舱坐下，帘缝正对竞拍台。
台上摆着三件东西。
黑星矛短刃半成品。
娜迦旧核共振符石残片。
content_en:
Chapter 44 Shadow Blade Trade
"Seal the square first and protect the throne. Don't let the accounts go through the official document port. Once there is a reply from Qiwen, send it directly to the laboratory."
Melo responded, holding the file and rushing out.
Xian Yao has already laid out the cold blue flow model of the seventh culvert, and his fingertips are swiping quickly on the mirror. Luo Hui held down the ice on his right arm and just turned around when the contract mirror suddenly flashed.
Qiwen's text message came in.
"Arrived at Port Lane. Under the old breakwater, entrance to the Shadow Market."
…
The sea breeze penetrated into the bottom of the breakwater in the old city, leaving only a fishy coldness.
Qiwen stood in front of the black steel gate, swiping her thumb across the blade of the Shadow Blade, and a line of cold blue pure fire climbed up her wrist along her knuckles. She then wrapped up the ash energy supply tube that had been removed from the Naga Crystal Core Glove. It was so old and dirty that it looked like something left behind by someone who had been doing secret work for many years.
There were two retired iron guards at the door, one tall and one short, with bronze medals from the Red Gold Chamber of Commerce hanging on their chests. The dark purple crystal scanner scanned over and paused at her wrist.
Thin lights danced in strings.
The short iron guard glanced at her and patted the coded bronze medal into her palm.
"Inspect the goods in the material area first. Don't wander around."
Qiwen collected her cards and entered the door.
The cave is cut into grids by dark purple curtains. The wet stone was cold, and spark lines were buried in the walls, spewing out a fine mist of ash stabilizer from time to time. The air smelled of star salt, crystal sand and burnt welding.
She didn't look around, she just walked steadily.
Pass the stabilizer stall and pause for a while.
Pass the remnant section of the energy supply pipe and stop for another half breath.
This is the habit of secretly teaching middle-level people to buy materials.
She had to act like a buyer tonight.
In the middle of the materials area, packaging cans are stacked on a row of old shelves. Qiwen drew her fingertips across it and stopped on the third one.
The bottom of the jar was badly worn and a corner was chipped.
The old seal is still there.
Qishi.
Qiwen pressed her fingers on it and let go after just one click.
The material dealer next to him was wearing a gray cloak, lowering his head to sort out the wooden picks. Qiwen knocked on the shelf twice and asked the price in code.
The man first looked at the energy supply tube on her wrist before speaking.
"New goods from three days ago. The aisles are clean."
"Which passage?"
"It came from the underground of Yaodu. There is no secret cult brand." The material dealer turned the can over and rubbed the old seal with his thumb. "The delivery side found it too troublesome and didn't even bother to wipe it. My surname is Qi."
Qiwen didn't answer.
She only glanced at the batch number on the side, remembered it, turned around and left.
Enough.
Qizhong's side is not a leak.
Someone delivers it directly.
Further inside is the auction concealed cabin area.
The wreckage of a decommissioned ironclad ship hangs in the center of the cave. The bow of the ship has been cut open and the deck has been transformed into a bidding platform. Buyers with blue curtains, sellers with purple curtains, accounting offices with black curtains.
Qiwen chose a dark cabin with blue curtains and sat down, with the curtain facing the bidding table.
There are three things on the table.
Black Star Spear short blade semi-finished product.
Fragments of old Naga nuclear resonance runestones.
